$meta.name: SerieN Autumn Railways — UI specification
$meta.audience: Implementing developer (Sol). Machine-readable companion of docs/SerieN-UI-Blueprint.pdf.
$meta.sourceOfTruth: reference/serien-ui-reference.html (visual + behaviour). If this file and the reference disagree, the reference wins; report the mismatch.

files.reference/serien-ui-reference.html: Self-contained working reference (mock simulation). Open in Chrome. Query param ?trains=0..8 previews any train count.
files.css/serien-ui.css: Production stylesheet, 1:1 with reference. ORDER-DEPENDENT. Do not reorder/split.
files.tokens/tokens.css: Fonts @import + design tokens (--sn-*) + core shorthands. Load first.
files.assets/svg/serien-sprite.svg: Gradients, icons, loco silhouettes, edition emblem. Inline once in <body>.
files.assets/textures/*.jpg: Brushed brass, enamel, brushed steel, mahogany, parchment, spun brass (gauge bezels).
files.library/serien-ui-library.html: Component gallery with every state, live CSS.
files.docs/SerieN-UI-Blueprint.pdf: Human blueprint + migration guide from current prototype.

rootContract.rootElement: <main id="st" class="st" data-tab="treni">  (ids and classes below are REQUIRED; CSS and behaviour depend on them)
rootContract.sidePanelDomOrder: m-sw, m-env, m-ms, m-lg in DOM; VISUAL order is set by CSS `order`: Environment, Switches, Map, Missions. Keep DOM as in reference.

layout.viewport3D: Engine canvas goes INSIDE .win as first child (position:absolute; inset:0). Delete .vph placeholder and the hidden svg.lay3d. Overlays (#nx, #slip, #cam) stay as siblings after the canvas.
layout.pointerEvents: .win itself must pass pointer events to the engine canvas; only .ov elements capture clicks.

components.notes: Mahogany texture, two brass rivets .rvp. Height equals edition plate.
Two slotted screws .scr. Swap name/emblem per edition; nothing else changes.

states.blk: added to 'al' when unacknowledged: blinks 1.1 s

components.click: acknowledge all alarms of that channel + select involved train

items.#snd: toggle sound; label 'Sound: On|Off'; mirrors Menu > Sound

components.collapsed: #nxh row: lamp, #nxn switch id, #nxd distance mm
components.expandWhen: user click (toggle .open) OR (distance<500 mm AND selected train moving) -> class .near (amber lamp, warn sound once)
components.binding: first facing-point switch ahead of the SELECTED train on its current route
components.action: #nxs buttons set that switch (same as tile)

components.binding: highest-priority active alarm (al > wn); 'in' items never shown
components.actions: from alarm.actions + 'Show' (select train) + 'Ack' for red alarms

tile.markup: IDdescription

states..nx1: is the next switch of the selected train (soft pulse)

tile.grid: 2 columns; N tiles generated from the game switch registry (NOT hard-coded)

components.map: svg.map: <use href=#lay> track twice (sepia + dashed); #md switch dots (.mdot, .dv amber); #mm train markers (.tm; .s selected pulses; .wn/.al); #mr predicted route of selected train in its colour
components.key: #mkl rows button.mkr: brass dot (halo = train colour), name, .k1 run time, .k2 distance; .on selected; .run moving (green dot); .al alarm

fields.#mnx: Next mission; disabled until progress = 1; panel gets .dn when complete (green bar, chime once)

components.arrows: #aL/#aR scroll by one card; disabled at ends; hidden when no trains
components.cardWidth: 3 per row desktop, 2 below 760 px container, 1 below 430 px; cards grow when fewer trains (max half width)

states..sel: selected (double brass ring, top sheen bar, brass name plate)

parts.gauge: svg.gg from gauge(train): main SPEED % needle .nd shows ACTUAL speed; sub-dial .nd2 = BAR (steam) or RPM (diesel/shunter)
parts.nameRow: .tg colour dot, svg.lc <use href=#l{kind}>, h3 name, .pl status pill
parts.caption: .cap '{type} · {era} · {wagons} · {length}'
parts.buttons: [data-a] rev, stop, lt (.on when lights on), unc, cpl — icon + small label

items.#rst: Reset: HOLD 900 ms (red fill, custom property --h 0..1); early release cancels; keyboard: hold Space/Enter while focused
items..mush: STOP ALL mushroom: press = latch E-stop (.lt2, label 'RE LEASE'); press again = release (.tw twist animation)

components.close: Esc, click on backdrop, Resume; focus returns to the opener

components.content: Large parchment track plan; switch labels .tpl (amber when diverging); click toggles switch; #tpC counter

stateModel.$note: The UI is a VIEW of this state. Produce it from the game every tick (or on change) and call the render functions. Field names are a recommendation; keep them stable.

trains.name: 'BR 055'
trains.kind: 1 steam | 2 diesel | 3 shunter (selects silhouette l{kind} and gauge type)
trains.subDial: pressure bar (steam) or rpm (diesel) — optional, UI can derive from speedActual like the reference

layoutGraph.$note: Track geometry in layout units for Map and Track plan. Reference uses PDF units (4022 x 1916 for 150 x 70 cm). Provide from the game's track model.

events.$transport: UI -> game: window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('serien:ui',{detail:{type,...}})) (reference already does this for 'exit'). Any bus is fine; keep the payloads.

alarmRules.$note: Evaluated about 6 times per second along each train's ACTUAL route through current switch positions. Port scanAhead()/scan() from the reference into the game layer if the game does not have them.

rules.when: moving train, another train ahead within 450 mm
rules.title: Collision risk

rules.when: distance <= 100 mm; train auto-held at 90 mm (emergency brake)
rules.title: Emergency brake

rules.when: moving train will enter a switch from the trailing side set against it, within 450 mm
rules.title: Points set against

rules.when: train held at that switch (<= 3 mm)
rules.title: Points set against

rules.when: moving train within 350 mm of a buffer stop
rules.title: Buffer stop ahead

alarmRules.sounds: new 'al' -> SFX.alarm (not for E-stop); new 'wn' -> SFX.warn
alarmRules.acknowledge: Ack button or annunciator click stops blinking; alarm stays until its condition clears

keyboard.Space: STOP ALL / release (ignored when a button has focus)
keyboard.ignore: when focus is in a dialog, when a range input uses arrows, with Ctrl/Meta/Alt

sound.engine: Web Audio synthesis, no audio files (object SFX in the reference: port as-is)
sound.unlock: AudioContext resumes on first user gesture

events.joint: rail joints every 124 mm, panned by x, quieter for non-selected trains

lighting.inputs: timeOfDay v: sunset LK = max(0, 1-|v-50|/34); night LN = clamp((v-42)/50, 0, 1)
lighting.night: set --n = LN on #st (CSS transition 1.2 s); add .nt when LN > 0.5. Everything else is CSS: panels darken (--dk overlay), gauges get the hidden-bulb layer (.gnt), enamel controls get warm edge light, brass buttons get grazing light from below. No canvas at night.
lighting.sunset: canvas.lx (multiply) warm wash, cut out over .win; disabled in Low quality
lighting.3Dview: lighting of the 3D scene is the engine's job; send setTimeOfDay

low: no decorative animation (sheen, pulses, lamp breathing)

referenceJs.$note: Functions inside the <script> of reference/serien-ui-reference.html. KEEP = port as-is. ADAPT = keep the rendering, feed it from game state. MOCK = delete and replace with game data/logic.
KEEP: hold-to-reset block (startH / stopH / doReset -> emit reset)
ADAPT: mk (create card + markers + key row from a train)
routeUpd (draw #mr from train.predictedRoute; HUD from train.nextSwitch)
MOCK: scanAhead (move into the game if needed)
requestAnimationFrame movement loop (speedActual integration, KPI accumulation, totD)
LAY / MT / toP / toPh / scenery (old 3D placeholder, already hidden)

acceptance: Visual check at 1440×900 against the PDF screenshots (with fonts loaded): layout, spacing, colours match.
0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8 trains: no overflow, carousel arrows correct, empty states at 0.
Selected train highlighted on card, map marker and key row; keys 1–8 select.
Switch thrown from tile, HUD and Track plan: all three + map dot update; counter correct.
STOP ALL latches (throttles disabled, annunciator red); second press releases.
Reset requires a 900 ms hold; a short press does nothing.
Each alarm rule produces lamp, slip, card ring, marker colour and sound; Ack stops blinking.
Night: panels dim, gauges/controls lit by hidden bulbs, ~1.2 s transition; no glow pools.
Low quality: no textures/blur/decorative animation; alarms still blink.
1024×768, 1280×800, 1920×1080, 390×844: nothing clipped; side column fits; phone bottom nav works.
Keyboard: every shortcut works; Esc closes dialogs; focus ring visible (2 px #fff3c4).
